name: compound_scaffold_feature

name: compound_safe_deploy
description: SUPER TOOL: Git push + wait for Vercel deployment + verify status in one call.

name: compound_onboard_saas_customer
description: SUPER TOOL: Full SaaS customer onboarding — Stripe customer + subscription + Clerk org + welcome email in one call.

name: compound_incident_response
description: SUPER TOOL: Pull together an incident context — Sentry errors + recent Vercel deployments — to guide root cause analysis.

name: compound_neon_safe_migration
description: SUPER TOOL: Run a DB migration on a temp Neon branch first, verify it works, then report whether it's safe to apply to main.

name: compound_git_commit_push
description: SUPER TOOL: Stage, commit, and push in one call — git add + commit + push.

name: compound_project_health_check
description: SUPER TOOL: Cross-service project health — GitHub issues/PRs + Vercel deployments + Neon connection + Sentry errors.

name: compound_send_dispatch_notification
description: SUPER TOOL: Send a driver SMS (Twilio) and customer email (Resend) for a service appointment in one call.

name: compound_generate_and_embed
description: SUPER TOOL: Generate an OpenAI embedding for text and immediately store it in Qdrant as a vector point.

name: compound_semantic_search
description: SUPER TOOL: Convert a text query to an OpenAI embedding and search Qdrant — semantic search in one call.

name: compound_analytics_snapshot
description: SUPER TOOL: Pull key business metrics from Stripe — MRR, ARR, active subscriptions.

name: compound_deploy_and_release
description: SUPER TOOL: Git push + Vercel deploy + Sentry release creation in one call — the full CI/CD deployment workflow.

name: compound_customer_offboard

name: compound_payment_failed_flow
description: SUPER TOOL: Find all past-due Stripe subscriptions and send dunning reminder emails via Resend.

name: compound_customer_support_context
description: SUPER TOOL: Pull together all context for a support ticket — Stripe billing history + Clerk profile + Sentry errors.

name: compound_local_llm_rag
description: SUPER TOOL: Local RAG pipeline — Ollama embed → Qdrant semantic search → Ollama generate answer with context. Zero API cost.

name: compound_sync_users_to_audience
description: SUPER TOOL: Fetch users from Clerk (or Neon SQL) and sync them to a Resend audience for email marketing.

name: compound_geocode_and_store
description: SUPER TOOL: Mapbox geocode an address and store the coordinates in a Neon database record.

name: compound_revenue_summary
description: SUPER TOOL: Combined Stripe revenue dashboard — MRR + ARR + active subs + past-due customers in one call.

name: compound_validate_env_vars
description: SUPER TOOL: Check that all required environment variables are set for a given list of service namespaces.

services.description: Service names to check: stripe, clerk, neon, vercel, etc. Omit to check all.

name: compound_full_health_dashboard
description: SUPER TOOL: Ping every configured service and return a unified health report — Ollama, Neon, Vercel, GitHub, Stripe, Sentry, Qdrant.

name: compound_batch_embed_documents
description: SUPER TOOL: Embed and store a batch of documents in Qdrant using OpenAI or Ollama embeddings — bulk knowledge base ingestion in one call.

use_ollama.description: Use Ollama instead of OpenAI for embeddings

name: compound_rollback_transaction
description: SUPER TOOL: Safety net — reads the Observability Ledger and reverses recent state-mutating tool calls in reverse order. Supports dry_run to preview the plan before executing. USE THIS WHEN a multi-step setup goes wrong or an agent hallucinated a destructive action.

last_n.description: Roll back the most recent N reversible ledger entries

since.description: ISO timestamp — roll back everything after this time

transaction_id.description: Roll back a single ledger entry by ID

dry_run.description: Show what would be reversed without executing
